name: robots/unity-technologies__robotics-object-pose-estimation
title: UR3 pick-and-place planner (Unity object pose estimation demo)
intro: UR3 pick-and-place planner (Unity object pose estimation demo), adapted from unity-technologies/robotics-object-pose-estimation. It runs `plan_pick_and_place`. `plan_pick_and_place`: plan (never execute) the five UR3 pick-and-place trajectories; executed is false. A command: it changes the node's shared planner, so never call while Unity plans; a zero quaternion is refused. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
